text_block_list.text:
Mejiro McQueen was hard at work training 
for the Kikuka Sho, but—

She witnessed firsthand the fierce 
determination of Mejiro Ryan,
who was also 
aiming to win the Kikuka Sho.

Mejiro McQueen grows fiercely determined 
not to lose.
Responding to those feelings, 
Mejiro Ryan challenges her to an all-out, 
serious showdown.

Mejiro McQueen accepted the challenge. 
...A promise was forged between the
Mejiro 
family Umamusume for a serious showdown
at the Kikuka Sho.
